concepts.title: Guided Thread
concepts.prompt_direction: Two bounded execution lanes converge at one proof point, suggesting guided work and replayable evidence.
concepts.strength: The most distinct motion metaphor; clear in a sidebar badge.
concepts.tradeoff: The open, horizontal silhouette needs a compact SVG redraw before 24px use.

concepts.title: Shared Kernel
concepts.prompt_direction: Three bounded modules lock around a single core, expressing one kernel across capabilities.
concepts.strength: Best expression of the unified Agent architecture and balanced square footprint.
concepts.tradeoff: More abstract; it needs the wordmark to establish the product name initially.

concepts.title: Evidence Beacon
concepts.prompt_direction: A durable document-like frame, one evidence point, and a traceable internal path.
concepts.strength: Most directly connected to public sources, task transcripts, and verifiable output.
concepts.tradeoff: Closest to a document motif, so it is less neutral if Harness grows beyond knowledge work.
